bayts.text: Through me preserve the wise Remembrance (the Qurʾān) with the Ḥadīth, O Generous, and make me a preserver, understanding of what is obscure and hidden.
O You who give gifts before any asking or request, give what drives error from me and raises my aspirations.
And subject to me the Accursed and the soul (Nafs), O Kind, Merciful, and grant a lasting certainty that leads me to the upright way.
And make me love right guidance, and save me from aggression, and make me reach the goal, by Your all-encompassing gentleness.
And magnify my standing before the assembly, grant me hope, and raise my station to the heights, like a fire on top of a mountain.
And be a Helper, O Helper, to everyone who helps me, and whoever comes at me to humiliate me, strike him down, O Lord of punishments!
Truly, upon You, O Most High, I have placed my reliance: so grant me the best of hopes and make firm my foot.
And save me from weariness, and heal all my ailments, and cleanse my breast from stain and darkness.
And make me one of humble devotion, and make me one of submission, and make me obedient, with the Great Majority (As-Sawād al-Aʿẓam).
Turn away from me innovations, so that I am seen a follower, and make God-fearing piety, scrupulousness, asceticism and truthfulness my character.
And never cease to be my leader in gentleness, and be my shepherd, and do not be one who distracts me from You by gathering blessings.
O Lord, grant me protection, bless my blessings, and magnify my portion with You, O Lord of the portions.
And be my guide to the way of the best of those who have risen high, and lead my time to the heights, as the noble are led.
You are my hope, O Eternal Refuge; You are my beginning, O One; You are my end, O Unique, O Lord of subsistence and of eternity without beginning.
Receive my complaint, O Generous, and have mercy on my weeping, O Merciful, answer my supplication, O Knowing, You who brought me out of nothingness.
By You, my God, make me independent of creatures, and guide me by You to You, O Rich, and do not cast me into ruin.
Remove my ugliness and my fault, relieve my worry and my grief, renew through me the path by Your favour, O Lord of generosity.
Grant me, my God, my quest, without hardship or toil, and restrain all ruin from those who belong to me.
And cut off, my God, whatever hinders me from what is magnified, and be for me the One who completes my shortfall in thanking for blessings.
And all that belongs to me, of prose or of verse, make it, O Lord of generosity, a light for the one who learns.
So accept for Your servant who has hoped, in this and that, for none but the Intercessor, the eminent, after You, O Eternal.
And turn his heart to You, and never cease to love him, and remove from him his sin, for he is full of remorse.
And suffice him against all ruin, and fill his heart with guidance, and here and tomorrow grant him a good ending.
O You who, when You say "Be!" (Kun) to any matter, it is: be the Answerer of my call, by the standing of him who goes before.
Answer my supplication, O Answerer, and forgive my sins, O Near, and forgive everyone who turns back, by the Chosen One, the Magnified.
And send blessings and peace upon him, as many as earth and sky, upon him, O You who became great, and upon those who belong to him.
